why: Reborn is the sibling volume of Road to Reborn and carries the same LOCG #1-248 hull; when its sibling was retracted it picked up 99 files, including Captain America (2024) issues
Return to Vader's Castle picked up the six files its sibling Tales from Vader's Castle had been holding - the later minis, not its own chapters
Dragon Age - Magekiller picked up the five files its sibling Knight Errant had been holding; they are separate Dragon Age minis, not its chapters
Gunsmith Cats Revised Edition 03 picked up the Revised Edition volumes its sibling 02 had been holding - its own siblings and itself
